review_notes: I read the whole file. I found no avoidable competing version of an existing Mathlib concept. The file defines open immersions for PresheafedSpace, SheafedSpace and LocallyRingedSpace. SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion and LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion are abbrevs over the PresheafedSpace class, so they are not independent declarations. The repeated opensFunctor, invApp, lift and isoRestrict declarations at the three levels are named specialisations or wrappers, and the rubric does not count those as defects. I grepped Mathlib for opensFunctor, isoOfRangeEq, toSheafedSpace and toLocallyRingedSpace. The only other isoOfRangeEq is the Scheme-level one in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/OpenImmersion.lean. It is a different category, and it builds on the declarations in this file. I did not check every downstream use of the wrappers, so some uncertainty remains.
